report.strategy: The long thesis is conditional on price holding above the SMA20 near 378.26 and the 375.70 low, then reclaiming 383.34 with stronger tape. It is strengthened by higher-low formation, improving bid depth, and volume converting into upside expansion; it weakens if churn persists below the high or SMA20 is lost. Missing evidence includes order-flow imbalance, taker buy/sell pressure, and a news or liquidity catalyst.
report.bull_summary: Price is holding above SMA20 and near the 24h low, with a tight spread and substantial quote volume, suggesting compression above support that could resolve upward if 383.34 is reclaimed.
report.bear_summary: Flat 24h change and failure to hold the 383.34 high show weak momentum; a loss of SMA20 or 375.70 could turn compression into downside expansion.
risks: No headline catalyst and zero 24h change leave the long dependent on technical compression
Failed reclaim of 383.34 could confirm supply overhead
Liquidity can thin quickly despite current volume
Break of SMA20 exposes the 375.70 low
i_am_wrong_if: Heavy sell volume appears on a break below SMA20
Repeated rejections at 383.34 produce lower highs
Realized volatility expands while price trades lower
report.invalidation_note: Long is invalidated if last trades at or below 375.6 (adverse move below the 379.29 snapshot).
report.reason: The lean is modestly long only because price remains above SMA20 and the 24h low has held, but confidence is limited by no catalyst, flat momentum, and lack of order-flow evidence.
